note: The entry follows Silvestri's 1901 original diagnosis; the original is a library OCR text of a BHL fascicle.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, the other segments elongate. Body length 4.3 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The original was published as Eutermes arenarius subsp. proximus, the original description being a short Latin diagnosis recording only the two characters above; locality Coxipó, Brazil. Holmgren 1910 redescribed it as a separate species and gave its position in the key (p. 249).
